description: This file defines a WebSocket client class for managing WebSocket connections, including connection handling, message sending, event listeners, and reconnection logic, specifically for the Mattermost platform.

classes.name: WebSocketClient
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket connections with reconnection, message handling, and event listener support for the Mattermost platform.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket connection with the specified URL, optional token, and posted acknowledgment flag.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up event listeners and timers.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message over the WebSocket, optionally with a response callback.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with specified action and data over the WebSocket, with optional response callback.

methods.name: userTyping
methods.description: Notifies the server that a user is typing in a specific channel and parent message.

methods.name: updateActiveChannel
methods.description: Updates the server about the active channel.

methods.name: updateActiveTeam
methods.description: Updates the server about the active team.

methods.name: updateActiveThread
methods.description: Updates the server about the active thread view.

methods.name: acknowledgePostedNotification
methods.description: Acknowledges a posted notification with status and optional reason and data.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Requests user statuses from the server.

methods.name: getStatusesByIds
methods.description: Requests statuses for specific user IDs.
